# Unitree Go2

```{image} ../../imgs/unitree_go2.jpg
:alt: The Unitree Go2 environment
:width: 60%
:align: center
```

The Go2 is a quadruped robot by Unitree Robotics. The model comes from MuJoCo Menagerie.

## Quick start

The registered name of this environment is `UnitreeGo2`. There is no motion capture data for it, so it is created with {class}`~loco_mujoco.task_factories.rl_factory.RLFactory`, whose default task is to track a commanded root velocity.

`````{tab-set}
````{tab-item} MuJoCo (CPU)
```python
from loco_mujoco.task_factories import RLFactory

env, _ = RLFactory.make("UnitreeGo2")

import numpy as np

env.reset()
for _ in range(1000):
    action = np.random.uniform(-1.0, 1.0, env.info.action_space.shape)
    obs, reward, absorbing, done, info = env.step(action)
    env.render()
```
````
````{tab-item} MJX (GPU)
```python
import jax

from loco_mujoco.task_factories import RLFactory

env, _ = RLFactory.make("MjxUnitreeGo2")

n_envs = 1024
reset = jax.jit(jax.vmap(env.mjx_reset, in_axes=(0, None)))
step = jax.jit(jax.vmap(env.mjx_step, in_axes=(0, 0, None)))

keys = jax.random.split(jax.random.key(0), n_envs)
state = reset(keys, None)
action = jax.vmap(env.sample_action_space)(keys)
state = step(state, action, None)
```
````
`````

## Constructor options

This embodiment has no arguments of its own.

All environments also accept `spec`, `observation_spec` and `actuation_spec` to replace the model, the observation space and the set of actuators, and the arguments of {class}`~loco_mujoco.environments.base.LocoEnv` and {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.mujoco_base.Mujoco`, such as `timestep`, `n_substeps`, `reward_type`, `control_type` or `terrain_type`. See the [modular architecture](../user_guide/modular_architecture.md).

## Observation space

The default observation has 35 dimensions: the pose of the floating base without its horizontal position, the joint positions, the velocity of the floating base and the joint velocities. A task factory may append further entries; {class}`~loco_mujoco.task_factories.rl_factory.RLFactory`, for example, adds the velocity goal. See [observations](../user_guide/observations.md) for how to change the observation space.

| Index | Name | Observation type | Dim | Model element |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0–4 | `q_root` | {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.observations.base.FreeJointPosNoXY` | 5 | `root` |

## Action space

The action has 12 dimensions, one per actuator, each in [-1, 1]. The default control type, {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.control_functions.default.DefaultControl`, maps this interval linearly to the control range of each actuator, so an action is a normalized actuator command. Another [control function](../user_guide/control_functions.md) can be selected with `control_type`.

| Index | Actuator | Acts on | Type | Joint range | Control range |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `FR_hip` | `FR_hip_joint` | torque | [-1.047, 1.047] | [-23.7, 23.7] |
| 1 | `FR_thigh` | `FR_thigh_joint` | torque | [-1.571, 3.491] | [-23.7, 23.7] |
| 2 | `FR_calf` | `FR_calf_joint` | torque | [-2.723, -0.8378] | [-45.43, 45.43] |
| 3 | `FL_hip` | `FL_hip_joint` | torque | [-1.047, 1.047] | [-23.7, 23.7] |
| 4 | `FL_thigh` | `FL_thigh_joint` | torque | [-1.571, 3.491] | [-23.7, 23.7] |
| 5 | `FL_calf` | `FL_calf_joint` | torque | [-2.723, -0.8378] | [-45.43, 45.43] |
| 6 | `RR_hip` | `RR_hip_joint` | torque | [-1.047, 1.047] | [-23.7, 23.7] |
| 7 | `RR_thigh` | `RR_thigh_joint` | torque | [-0.5236, 4.538] | [-23.7, 23.7] |
| 8 | `RR_calf` | `RR_calf_joint` | torque | [-2.723, -0.8378] | [-45.43, 45.43] |
| 9 | `RL_hip` | `RL_hip_joint` | torque | [-1.047, 1.047] | [-23.7, 23.7] |
